{{Top|leg}}
A '''crash balloon''' was a safety device intended to protect the pilot of an [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]] in the event of a crash. It was designed to be used alongside a [[restraint harness]] and possibly an [[emergency acceleration compensator]] in order to prevent the pilot from hitting a hard surface during the sudden deceleration of a crash. The Skiprays owned by [[Talon Karrde]] while he had a base on Myrkr were equipped with crash balloons.<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This is the Star Wars analog to the real-world [[Wikipedia:Airbag|airbags]] used in cars and other passenger vehicles.
